🌫 Murky water: water around quarries, kilns, factories, workshops, ports and industrial zones gets cloudy. Murky water near homes means fewer residents and less happiness, and homes need 40 or less for Lv.3, 25 for Lv.4 and 15 for Lv.5. Build several 🫧 Water Filters from ⚙ Utilities to clean it, and check it on the 🗺 map.
⚖ Town Policies (☰ Menu) unlock at Coral Hall Lv.6. Each policy has a benefit and a cost. You get one more slot at Lv.10 and Lv.15.

⚠ Town incidents: from Coral Hall Lv.6, sharks, hot water vents, colds and red tides sometimes happen. Inside the range of a 🚒 Fire Station, 👮 Patrol or 🏥 Clinic they are stopped automatically; otherwise tap the building to fix it or wait 2 hours.
💨 Breath Springs · Big Breath Towers (⚙ Utilities) can be built as many times as you like. Place them where the Oxygen Pump does not reach to widen the area where zones can grow.

🚦 Traffic: roads crowded with homes, shops, workshops and workplaces get jammed. Next to a jammed road, production, move-ins and happiness drop, and zones need unjammed roads to reach Lv.4+. Use ⬆ Widen roads in the 🛣 Roads tab for gravel roads (Lv.5) and coral avenues (Lv.12), or place 🚌 Current Bus Stops from ⚙ Utilities. Check it on 🗺 Map → Traffic.
